While everyone talks about using AI to generate social media posts, the real quiet superpower is AI meeting assistants. Tools that quietly join your client calls, capture every detail, pull out clear action items, and draft your recap emails before you even close your laptop.

Automation doesn't have to mean replacing the human touch—it just frees you up to actually focus on your clients instead of admin work.

Have you tried an AI assistant on your calls yet, or are you still team pen and paper?
